items.title: 5 tips for parents worried about their kids' screen time and online safety
items.summary: Parental monitoring can help protect kids from the harms of social media and excess screen time. Screen time boundaries plus early and open conversations about online habits can make kids less vulnerable.

items.title: Photos: This may be the most inspirational night school on Earth
items.summary: Many thousands of boys and men in Lesotho take up the vital profession of herding but have to give up their education. A small network of schools on a shoestring budget is teaching them the ABCs.
